title: Derived global germ compatibility with exchange
statement: For any cartesian square (f,f′,g,g′) [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square], any separably closed geometric point t of Y′ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks], and K∈D⁺(X_et,Ab) [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], the canonical derived pulled global germ followed by D(stalk_t) of exchange [def-weil-pbc-derived-exchange] equals RΓ of the derived adjunction unit followed by Leray and then the target canonical derived global germ [def-weil-pbc-derived-global-germ]. No invertibility of either germ, strict-local hypothesis, properness or torsion is assumed.

proof.text: Use a bounded below injective representative I for K and an injective replacement J of its exact inverse image. The termwise exchange formula computes exchange on I followed by pushforward of replacement. Global germs are natural and the inverse-image stalk isomorphism respects unit germs, so this termwise composite equals the pullback-of-sections unit followed by replacement and the target germ. Expand upperStarCompSheafFiberIso into sheafPullbackIso, sheafFiberComapIso and pointSmallEtaleComapIso and use their germ/unit formulas directly. The algebraically closed wrapper inverseImage_stalk_germ is not applicable to a merely separably closed field and is not used.

Use right-derived extensionality and the unit compatibilities of derived natural transformations, exact-functor comparisons and Leray to transport the termwise equality to the chosen D⁺ functors. The derived-unit formula identifies the transported pullback of sections with RΓ of the derived adjunction unit followed by Leray.
